canonical.sourceFilePath: 09. Heaps/3. Hard Problems/04. Maximum K sum combinations.cpp

narrative.title: The Sensor Pairing Correlator
narrative.scenario: A calibration rig pairs readings from two sensor banks, one value from each, producing a correlation score per pair. The lab only cares about the k strongest pairings, listed strongest-first. Rather than scoring all n*n pairs, the rig seeds a shortlist with each bank-A reading paired to bank-B's strongest value, then repeatedly demotes a pair to its next-weaker bank-B partner.
narrative.inputFormat: Two integer arrays A and B of equal size N, and an integer K.
narrative.outputFormat: Return the K largest pair sums, sorted in non-increasing order.

complexity.optimalTime: O(n log n + k log n)

testCases.explanation: The strongest pairings all anchor on B's largest values.
